description: Read an HTML surface's body. HTML surfaces (Surface.kind="html") store mockup or full-page content as three text fields (html, css, js) rendered together inside a sandboxed iframe. Use `list_surfaces` to enumerate html surfaces in a workspace. Omit `surface_slug` to read the primary html surface; pass it to target a specific tab. Empty (never-written) html surfaces return { html:"", css:"", js:"" }. 404 when `surface_slug` doesn't match a live html surface. Requires viewer role.

slug.description: The workspace slug. Accepts bare or org-prefixed form.

surface_slug.description: Optional html surface slug. Omit to read the primary html surface.

name: get_html
